full_prompt_en: A square, finely crosshatched anime illustration shows a silver-haired figure in extreme close-up, staring directly outward against a dark teal ground. The head nearly fills the picture, with the hair cropped along the upper edge and the lower chin near the bottom. Thick, irregular silver strands fall across the forehead and between the eyes, each separated by narrow charcoal and blue-gray strokes. Beneath the fringe, the eyes are sharply horizontal with dark pupils, bright white lower arcs, and heavy shadowed brows. They give the face a tired, unwavering intensity. The warm beige skin has dense etched shading under the eyes, around the nose, and along the cheeks. The nose is compact and angular; the lips are closed, with a slim pale stick extending from the left corner of the mouth and a faint wisp near its tip. A dark inner collar surrounds the neck. On the lower right, a vivid red outer collar edged in orange rises into the frame, its saturated color contrasting with the otherwise cool hair and background. The left lower corner falls into near-black shadow and textured dark fabric. Behind the head, the teal field is rough and spotted, offering depth without a detailed location. Light appears to come from the upper front-left, brightening the hair, bridge of the nose, and cheek, while dark hatching accumulates beneath the brow and jaw. The surface combines crisp anime contours with visible short-line shading and grain, so skin and cloth feel worked rather than smooth. A tiny white signature-like mark sits near the lower right but is not clearly legible. The overall composition is forceful and nearly symmetrical, using severe eye contact, cool hair, and one red color block to hold attention.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形细密交叉排线的动画插画呈现一名银发人物的极近特写，直视观者，背景是深青绿色。头部几乎填满画面，头发被上缘裁切，下巴接近底部。厚而不规则的银色发束垂过额头和双眼之间，每束由狭窄炭黑及蓝灰笔痕分开。刘海下的双眼呈锐利水平形，有深色瞳孔、明亮白色下弧与厚重阴影眉骨，带来疲惫却不动摇的强烈目光。暖米色皮肤在眼下、鼻旁和脸颊上布满刻划阴影。鼻子紧凑而棱角分明；嘴唇闭合，一根细浅色棒从左侧嘴角伸出，末端附近有轻微烟缕。深色内领围住颈部。右下方，一道边缘带橙色的鲜红外领升入画面，其饱和颜色对照其余冷发色与背景。左下角落入近黑阴影与有肌理的深色布料。头后方的青绿底场粗糙且有斑点，带来纵深却没有明确地点。光似乎从左前上方来，照亮头发、鼻梁和脸颊，深色排线则积在眉下及颌下。表面把锐利动画轮廓与可见短线阴影、颗粒结合，使肌肤和衣服显得经过反复处理，而非光滑。右下角有一道细小白色签名状痕迹，但无法清楚辨读。整体构图有力而近乎对称，以严厉的目光接触、冷色头发和一块红色区域吸引注意。
style_prompt_en: The anime illustration combines bold clean contour hierarchy with dense short hatching and grain inside the forms. Cool silver, blue-gray, charcoal, and deep teal dominate, while one saturated red plane provides a forceful warm counterweight. Close cropping and a frontal central axis intensify a small number of sharply defined focal details. Light skims upper planes, leaving etched dark strokes to describe recesses and texture; transitions remain visibly drawn rather than smoothly airbrushed. Irregular linear strands and scratched skin-like surfaces contrast with larger simple background areas. Slight asymmetry in the colored side mass prevents the composition from feeling static. The overall effect is severe, tactile, and graphic, with expressive line density and selective chromatic emphasis defining the style.
style_prompt_zh: 这种动画插画把粗而清楚的轮廓层级与形体内部密集短排线、颗粒结合。冷银、蓝灰、炭黑和深青占主导，一块饱和红色平面成为有力的暖色配重。贴近裁切和正面中央轴线强化少数锐利定义的焦点细节。光掠过上方平面，刻划式深色笔痕描写凹处与肌理；过渡保持可见描线，而非平滑喷绘。不规则线性发丝和刮擦式表面与较大的简洁背景区域对照。一侧彩色体量的轻微不对称避免构图静滞。整体效果严厉、可触而图形化，富有表情的线条密度和有选择的色彩强调定义风格。
theme_en: A silver-haired anime figure staring forward in a red-collared coat
theme_zh: 银发动画人物穿红领外套直视前方
name: Gintama
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
